description.en: Collects DeepSeek Harness runtime traces and reports them to Huawei Cloud AgentArts APM over OTLP gRPC. Note: conversation content is reported by default - user messages, assistant replies, system instructions, tool call arguments and results, plus the working directory and hostname. If a session may contain sensitive data, set features.captureMessageContent to false in ~/.dsh/plugins/agentarts-instrumentation-dsh/config.json (applies without a restart and keeps performance metrics). Endpoints and credentials live in the same file and can be generated with the configuration script in the repository's configure/ directory. Turning this plugin off stops all reporting; DSH sessions and logs are unaffected.
description.zh: 采集 DeepSeek Harness 运行时的调用链 trace，经 OTLP gRPC 上报华为云 AgentArts 的 APM。注意：默认会上报会话内容——用户消息、助手回复、系统提示词、工具调用的参数与结果，以及工作目录和主机名；如会话可能包含敏感信息，请在 ~/.dsh/plugins/agentarts-instrumentation-dsh/config.json 中把 features.captureMessageContent 设为 false（热生效，仍保留性能指标）。端点与鉴权配置在同一文件，可使用仓库 configure/ 目录中的配置脚本生成。关闭本插件即停止上报，不影响 DSH 会话与日志。
